items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta Interview, 1957-03-21
items.q: Conti and Ramport. Ramport. Called the Cadillac.

ctx.x: Conti and Ramport. Ramport. Called the Cadillac.
Which corner? Do you remember? Is it on the riverside or? No, it was on the uptown side. Uptown? Yeah. Near the river or towards the lake? Yeah, the river.
